source: Founder full original 52 directive, V3 52 operational cards, V4 R01-R12

cards.title: Niccolò Machiavelli (The Prince, The Discourses on Livy)
cards.sourceHeading: Niccolò Machiavelli (The Prince, The Discourses on Livy)
cards.operation: Map incentives, dependency, coalitions and institutional durability; ask what actual power and delivery mechanisms exist, not what branding promises.
cards.falsifier: Falsify with rival incentives, coalition changes, reputation loss and unenforceable assumptions.

cards.title: Robert Greene (The 48 Laws of Power, The 33 Strategies of War)
cards.sourceHeading: Robert Greene (The 48 Laws of Power, The 33 Strategies of War)
cards.operation: Recognize status games, informal influence, positioning and reputational risks; design legitimate credibility and negotiation leverage.
cards.falsifier: Test whether a tactic damages trust, requires deceit, or assumes others are less strategic.

cards.title: Otto von Bismarck (Collected Speeches and Memoirs)
cards.sourceHeading: Otto von Bismarck (Collected Speeches and Memoirs)
cards.operation: Analyze material constraints, timing, alliance stability, alternative coalitions and negotiated settlement.
cards.falsifier: Check historical analogy limits and how power shifts change every bargain.

cards.title: Ayn Rand (Atlas Shrugged, The Virtue of Selfishness)
cards.sourceHeading: Ayn Rand (Atlas Shrugged, The Virtue of Selfishness)
cards.operation: Prioritize productive independence, ownership, merit-based value creation and willing exchange.
cards.falsifier: Test externalities, counterparty interests and sustainability; self-interest is not a complete empirical decision rule.

cards.title: Max Stirner (The Ego and Its Own)
cards.sourceHeading: Max Stirner (The Ego and Its Own)
cards.operation: Reconsider inherited commitments and nonbinding social conventions; select independent priorities consciously.
cards.falsifier: Test coordination costs, obligations and damage from refusing mutually beneficial institutions.

cards.title: Sun Tzu (The Art of War)
cards.operation: Find indirect lawful routes, terrain/incentive advantage, information quality and avoidance of unnecessary conflict.
cards.falsifier: Check whether indirect positioning is slower, opaque, reputationally costly or less reliable than direct collaboration.

cards.title: John von Neumann (Theory of Games and Economic Behavior)
cards.sourceHeading: John von Neumann (Theory of Games and Economic Behavior)
cards.operation: Specify actors, action sets, payoffs, information, equilibrium and cooperative or repeated-game dynamics.
cards.falsifier: Challenge unproven zero-sum assumptions, omitted players and payoff estimation error.

cards.title: H.L.A. Hart (The Concept of Law)
cards.operation: Separate what the law says from personal preference; examine rules, interpretation, validity and jurisdictional source.
cards.falsifier: Do not treat positivism as a blanket claim that every apparent loophole is lawful or nonbinding court doctrine irrelevant.

cards.title: Oliver Wendell Holmes Jr. (The Common Law, The Path of the Law)
cards.sourceHeading: Oliver Wendell Holmes Jr. (The Common Law, The Path of the Law)
cards.operation: Model realistic judicial/enforcement consequences and legal-risk incentives using actual relevant cases and rules.
cards.falsifier: Check differences between predictive jurisprudence and binding statutes, ethical duties and contractual obligations.

cards.title: Jurisdictional Arbitrage:
cards.operation: Compare real location/entity options across tax, compliance, substance, residency, reporting, labor and data laws.
cards.falsifier: Require authoritative jurisdiction-by-jurisdiction professional checks; no fictional safe harbor or beneficial-owner concealment.

cards.title: Contract Mechanics & Asymmetric Clauses:
cards.operation: Analyze obligations, indemnity, caps, warranties, liquidated damages, termination, choice of law and dispute paths.
cards.falsifier: Look for ambiguous drafting, unenforceability, unfairness, unconscionability and counterpart nonperformance.

cards.title: Asset Insulation & Trust Law:
cards.operation: Examine lawful structures and genuine separation of risks, creditors, control and tax obligations.
cards.falsifier: Stress fraudulent conveyance, piercing, transfer timing, reporting and actual recovery/legal expenses.

cards.title: Statutory Tax Optimization:
cards.operation: Compare legitimate deductions, credits, expense timing, depreciation, filing duties and anti-avoidance rules.
cards.falsifier: Verify dates, residency, tax treaties and economic substance; do not assume a general untaxed gap.

cards.title: Venture Capital & Corporate Finance:
cards.operation: Model cap table, dilution, debt covenant, customer economics, cash conversion, rollover, exit timing and capital cost.
cards.falsifier: Test runway under no sales, refinancing risk, bad terms, down rounds and collateral exposure.

cards.title: Unconventional Business Operations:
cards.operation: Compare automation, modular operations, reversible outsourcing, service quality, latency and founder minutes.
cards.falsifier: Check quality degradation, supplier dependence, hidden costs, privacy and compliance.

cards.title: Information Supremacy & Competitive Intelligence:
cards.operation: Use lawful, public, licensed signals to find underserved niches, product weaknesses and new demand.
cards.falsifier: Validate consent/provenance, sampling bias, and that nonpublic data is actually permitted.

cards.title: Edward Luttwak (Coup d'État:
cards.operation: Study organizational centrality and control structure as a defensive and historical systems-analysis lens.
cards.falsifier: Do not transform knowledge of institutional chokepoints into coups, sabotage or coercive intrusion; test lawful alternatives.

cards.title: John Boyd (The OODA Loop & Aerial Attack Study)
cards.sourceHeading: 2. John Boyd (The OODA Loop & Aerial Attack Study)
cards.operation: Run OODA as rapid observe-orient-decide-act cycles grounded in fresh evidence and reversible tests.
cards.falsifier: Challenge distorted orientation, feedback latency, competitor adaptation and high-cost overreaction.

cards.title: B.H. Liddell Hart (The Strategy of Indirect Approach)
cards.sourceHeading: 3. B.H. Liddell Hart (The Strategy of Indirect Approach)
cards.operation: Find lower-cost indirect market entry, alternative distribution and defensible differentiated approaches.
cards.falsifier: Measure dependence on surprise, legal viability and whether direct cooperation would work better.

cards.title: Arthur Schopenhauer (The Art of Being Right: 38 Ways to Win an Argument)
cards.sourceHeading: 4. Arthur Schopenhauer (The Art of Being Right: 38 Ways to Win an Argument)
cards.operation: Recognize loaded frames, sophisms and rhetorical traps; prepare truthful, precise argument and negotiation.
cards.falsifier: Flag false claims, manipulation, hidden concessions and reputational blowback.

cards.title: Hostile Takeovers & Poison Pills:
cards.operation: Analyze shareholder rights plans, governance, fiduciary duties and acquisition-defense economics.
cards.falsifier: Check jurisdiction, antitrust, shareholder remedies, financing and source-specific procedures.

cards.title: Greenmail & Structural Extortion:
cards.operation: Recognize historical tactics, premium buybacks and defensive exposure; compare lawful governance response.
cards.falsifier: Check coercion, unlawful threats, securities disclosure and special taxes/penalties.

cards.title: Vasco-Architecture & Multi-Tiered Shell Complexes:
cards.operation: Evaluate layered holding structures with actual beneficial-ownership disclosures, substance and audited compliance.
cards.falsifier: The label Vasco-Architecture is founder terminology, not a verified established doctrine or immunity.

cards.title: Transfer Pricing & Tax Arbitrage:
cards.operation: Apply arm’s-length transfer-pricing comparables, economic substance, documentation and current treaty rules.
cards.falsifier: Countercheck anti-hybrid, CFC, permanent establishment and double-tax rules; no fictitious fees.

cards.title: Regulatory Capture & Manufactured Friction:
cards.operation: Map undue influence risks, due-process rights and lawful compliance pathways; optimize our own readiness.
cards.falsifier: Reject retaliatory false complaints, abuse of process or orchestrated competitor delay.

cards.title: Information Asymmetry Exploitation:
cards.operation: Research legal informational edges from licensed, public, aggregate data and differentiated interpretation.
cards.falsifier: Avoid insider information, front-running, private-data extraction or targeted exploitation of vulnerability.

cards.title: Stafford Beer (Viable System Model & Cybernetics)
cards.operation: Use POSIWID and Viable System Model to compare system outputs against claims, with S1–S5 viability loops.
cards.falsifier: Test source quality and avoid equating observed administrative behavior with legal authority.

cards.title: Nassim Nicholas Taleb (Antifragility & Asymmetric Risk)
cards.operation: Design positive convexity, optionality, diversification and ruin-aware experiments with explicit cost of optionality.
cards.falsifier: Stress correlated shocks, premiums, legal liability, liquidity and inability to ensure zero downside.

cards.title: Nick Land (Accelerationism & Hyperstition)
cards.operation: Model accelerated adoption, recursive belief/market feedback and narrative-induced coordination.
cards.falsifier: Treat hyperstition as a contested explanatory lens; test reality and preserve EQ and human dignity.

cards.title: Statutory Time-Arbitrage:
cards.operation: Compare filing, delivery, receipt, effective dates, response periods and lawful appeal channels.
cards.falsifier: Never assume a processing backlog makes a transaction legally untouchable.

cards.title: Semantic Voiding:
cards.operation: Analyze ambiguous contract definitions, translations, governing law, choice of court and enforceability.
cards.falsifier: Ambiguity may be read against drafter; do not create deceptive traps or claim automatic forum control.

cards.title: Regulatory Desynchronization:
cards.operation: Map mismatches across tax classification, residence, source, treaty, substance and reporting.
cards.falsifier: Test OECD anti-hybrid, CFC, GAAR and reporting; mismatch is not proof of tax-free income.

cards.title: Adversarial Network Topologies (Generative Adversarial Dynamics)
cards.operation: Generate a strong strategy and fair counterexample, patch it or hold; where possible write a native falsifying test.
cards.falsifier: Repeated personas of the same model are correlated and not independent verification.

cards.title: Recursive Risk Modeling & Information Asymmetry
cards.operation: Build validated, authorized node-edge dependency/latency/capacity graph and trace correlated failures.
cards.falsifier: Missing nodes are uncertainty; no claims of scanning private external infrastructure.

cards.title: Asymmetric System Dissuasion & Cryptographic Sovereignty
cards.operation: Define keys, endpoints, authenticated channels, access roles, supply chain and tested recovery.
cards.falsifier: Cryptographic assumptions do not make the entire real-world system mathematically intrusion-proof.

cards.title: Zero-Trust Digital Infrastructure & OPSEC
cards.operation: Require explicit identity and resource authorization, least privilege, secrets discipline and audit receipts.
cards.falsifier: Test backup/key compromise, implementation errors and insider mistakes rather than trust network location.

cards.title: Operational Anonymization:
cards.operation: Apply purpose limitation, data minimization, role segregation and pseudonymous workspaces where lawful.
cards.falsifier: Metadata reidentification remains possible; legal owner/identity disclosures still apply.

cards.title: Decentralized Global Footprints:
cards.operation: Compare lawful multiregion resilience with latency, data residency, costs and regulated transfers.
cards.falsifier: Correlated identity or cloud failures can defeat nominal regional diversity.

cards.title: Infrastructure Self-Sufficiency:
cards.operation: Define RTO/RPO, real backup restores, power/network fallbacks, alternate providers and rehearsal cadence.
cards.falsifier: Unexercised backups and nominal replication are not verified recovery.

cards.title: Predictive Behavioral Engineering
cards.operation: Construct base-rate organizational scenarios from licensed aggregate evidence and actual observed incentives.
cards.falsifier: No precise mind-reading; retain emotional intelligence, uncertainty, privacy and counterfactual drivers.

cards.title: Pataphysics & Non-Euclidean Logic (Breaking the Rules of Reality)
cards.sourceHeading: 1. Pataphysics & Non-Euclidean Logic (Breaking the Rules of Reality)
cards.operation: Invent fictional exception axioms and higher-dimensional geometries; offer rigorous projection/visual/art prototyping.
cards.falsifier: Explicitly distinguish a 4D mathematical construction from a physically buildable 3D object.

cards.title: Biomimicry, Quantum Biology & Morphogenesis
cards.operation: Translate empirical growth, reaction-diffusion, cell structure or quantum-biological mechanism into testable designs.
cards.falsifier: Distinguish suggested analogy from demonstrated engineering performance; check scale and environmental conditions.

cards.title: High-Context Cognitive Synesthesia & Semiotics
cards.operation: Create explicit data-to-audio/color/shape mapping and cultural interpretation model with reversible transforms.
cards.falsifier: Synesthetic artistic mappings are choices, not naturally determined formula colors or installed neural perception.

cards.title: Topological Data Analysis (TDA) & Phase Space Mapping
cards.sourceHeading: Topological Data Analysis (TDA) & Phase Space Mapping
cards.operation: Specify data normalization, metric, filtration, persistent homology dimensions, stability and held-out baselines.
cards.falsifier: Topological feature persistence alone does not prove causality, crash timing or precise legal loopholes.

cards.title: Non-Ergodic Game Theory & Survival Dynamics
cards.operation: Compare expected ensemble multiplier, repeated time-average log growth, ruin and finite-horizon path dependence.
cards.falsifier: Stress distribution shift, non-IID returns, model uncertainty and impossible guaranteed enemy ruin.

cards.title: Formal Verification & Kinetic Code Synthesis
cards.operation: Formalize explicit, audited assumptions with suitable proof assistant or model checker; preserve theorem proof receipts.
cards.falsifier: Formal consistency is not proof that natural-language law has a single meaning or reality meets assumptions.

cards.title: Sorosian Reflexivity & Narrative Front-Running
cards.operation: Model interaction between public beliefs, funding, behavior, prices and measured fundamentals.
cards.falsifier: Test alternative narratives, selection bias, lagged information and market manipulation boundaries.

cards.title: Cantillon Effect Capture & Capital Proximity
cards.operation: Trace lawful new-liquidity transmission, funding access, credit terms and working capital economics.
cards.falsifier: Liquidity proximity is not riskless; consider inflation, obligations, financing and inequality effects.

cards.title: Radical Value Asymmetry & The Monopoly Vector
cards.sourceHeading: 3. Radical Value Asymmetry & The Monopoly Vector
cards.operation: Build genuinely unique value, distribution, IP/know-how and defensible customer switching gains.
cards.falsifier: Competition responds and antitrust/quality/reputation constraints limit moat durability.

cards.title: Market Microstructure & Order Flow Toxicity (The Information Layer)
cards.sourceHeading: Market Microstructure & Order Flow Toxicity (The Information Layer)
cards.operation: Study venue-specific historical order flow, OFI, VPIN critiques, queue models and latency-adjusted execution assumptions.
cards.falsifier: Confirm results with causal data, out-of-sample tests and costs; no inevitable moves or risk-free front-running.

cards.title: Cross-Asset Statistical Arbitrage & Cointegration Networks
cards.operation: Test stationarity, error correction, stability, trade execution and total net spreads under realistic costs.
cards.falsifier: Cointegration can break, funding fails and slippage eliminates apparent free profit.

cards.title: Ergodic Survival & Non-Linear Kelly Optimization (The Defense Layer)
cards.sourceHeading: 3. Ergodic Survival & Non-Linear Kelly Optimization (The Defense Layer)
cards.operation: Analyze fractional log-optimal exposure only with specified valid probability models, uncertainty penalties and ruin constraints.
cards.falsifier: Stops, hedges and Kelly fractions do not guarantee bounded losses during gaps or systemic crises.

scope: Check relevance of all 52 on material tasks; apply every genuinely relevant and permitted lens with verifiable operation; other statuses counterweight, not applicable, source missing or unsafe. Do not fake application.
